why: Phase 32's fault library: every fault the demo services can be given, with the diagnosis `culprit diagnose` must reach. cli/cmd/culprit/faultlib_test.go injects each one into demo-services/faults/docker-compose.yml, runs the walk inside the named vantage container, and compares.
This is the regression suite for the product's core claim — the walk finds the root, not the symptom — and it runs in CI on every push (DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN.md Phase 32 field 15).

relations is the set of relations the fault tree must contain, exactly. rubric is §2.9; verified is false on every diagnosis: a diagnosis is never edited, and whether it is verified is a verification's to say (Phase 34).

fix is the known fix for each fault, applied by the test once the diagnosis is checked, and the verdict `culprit verify` must then give, run in the same vantage with the changes named. Three fixes are runtime actions — a firewall rule removed, an injected fault cleared — which are none of an image, a config key or a commit; they are named as a commit with a ref derived from the fix's name (sha1 of 'culprit fault library fix: <name>', first 12 hex characters), because no real commit applied them. A commit explains nothing a capture records, so the verdict still rests on the readings and on the environment not having changed. Raised for review as Q20.
scenarios are the verdicts a fix should not get: a wrong fix, a fix that breaks what passed, and a change underneath that nothing named explains.

faults.name: auth-audience
faults.inject: order-service presents a token minted for audience 'inventory', where inventory-service expects 'inventory-service'

fix.how: order-service recreated with a token minted for 'inventory-service'

faults.name: auth-audience-ungranted
faults.inject: the audience fault again, walked in an environment that does not grant config.inspect.values for order-service/INVENTORY_TOKEN
faults.note: Phase 32 part 2's token grant: without it the audience hypothesis is refused, the tree records the branch as unexplored, and the diagnosis is partial and names the missing grant.

fix.how: the same fix; the audience probe is still refused in this environment, so nothing can show it fixed

faults.name: network-partition
faults.inject: a REJECT rule in order-service's network namespace for inventory-service's address; neither container is stopped
faults.note: From inside order-service a refused connection to inventory-service is equally consistent with 'the path is cut' and 'inventory-service is down'; no reading from that vantage separates them, so discriminated is false. The root is the edge because the edge's own probe failed. Telling the two apart needs a second vantage, which arrives with the production agent (Phase 33).

faults.name: contract
faults.inject: inventory-service serves stock at /stock-levels; order-service calls /stock

fix.how: inventory-service recreated without CONTRACT_FAULT, serving /stock again

faults.name: error-rate
faults.inject: inventory-service answers 500 to every request through its fault middleware (shared/faults.py, rate 1.0)

faults.name: latency
faults.inject: inventory-service adds 800 ms to every request (shared/faults.py)
faults.note: No read-only probe discriminates 'slow'; every probe passes, and the walk says the cause is inside order-service or something it cannot observe, such as added latency — a partial diagnosis, not a wrong one. Latency waits for impedance to have a CLI source (docs/LIMITS.md).

fix.how: the injected latency cleared; the walk found no failing reading, so there is nothing a fix can be seen to fix

scenarios.name: wrong-fix
scenarios.how: order-service recreated with a token minted for 'inventory-svc' — still not the audience inventory-service expects

scenarios.name: regressed
scenarios.how: inventory-service serves /stock again, and payments-service now answers 500 to every request

scenarios.name: changed-underneath
scenarios.how: inventory-service serves /stock again, and order-service is recreated with a config key it did not have; only the contract fix is named

scenarios.name: no-change-named
scenarios.how: inventory-service serves /stock again, and nothing is named
